minor.name: Self-install pulls the published remote, not the working tree
minor.summary:
The marketplace source is the GitHub git URL, so the plugins this repo enables for itself come from the last pushed default branch (cached copy), not from the checkout being edited. Edits to plugins/ on a feature branch, such as this one, are not exercised by the repo's own sessions until they are merged and the cache refreshes. This may be intended (stable dogfooding), but it is not stated anywhere.

Also (overall): extraKnownMarketplaces points at the remote git URL, so every session in this repo runs the cached copy of the plugins from the pushed default branch (currently harness 0.2.0), while edits under plugins/ in the checkout are inert until merged, version-bumped and updated. README.md (lines 23-28) and CLAUDE.md document only the user-scope install; a contributor cloning the repo now gets a project-scope install prompt and hooks from a different revision than the code under review, with no note explaining which copy is live or how to exercise local changes.

Also (overall): README.md line 23 registers the marketplace as the GitHub shorthand `t968rs/operator-straps` (github source), while .claude/settings.json declares the same name `operator-straps` with a `git` source and full https URL. Both resolve to the same repository, but a user who followed the README already has `operator-straps` registered under a different source spec, which invites a source-mismatch prompt or a second registration of the same name.
fix: Keep as is and add a one-line note in the README install section that the repo uses the published marketplace.
Use a local directory source (a path or a git-ignored settings.local.json override) when testing in-repo plugin edits.

Add a short note to CLAUDE.md (Rules for changes or Tests) stating that .claude/settings.json enables the published marketplace, and that local plugin changes are exercised with `claude --plugin-dir plugins/<name>` or a local marketplace (`claude plugin marketplace add ./`) before merge.
Alternatively point the marketplace source at the checkout ({"source": "directory", "path": "."}) in .claude/settings.local.json for development, keeping the git source in the shared settings.
Use the github source form to match the README: "source": {"source": "github", "repo": "t968rs/operator-straps"}.
